en.title: Longest Proper Prefix That Is Also a Suffix
en.description:
Find the length of the longest string that is both a proper prefix and a proper suffix of the given string. It must be shorter than the whole string, the prefix and suffix may overlap, and the empty string of length 0 is valid.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol; ranges not given by the source are stated explicitly.
en.input: One line containing a lowercase string S of length 1..1000000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: abba appears at both the start and the end, so the length is 4. Example 2: there is no non-empty common proper prefix and suffix, so 0. Example 3: aaa is allowed to overlap, so the length is 3.
hints: Compute the KMP prefix function; its last entry is the length of the longest proper border of the whole string.
